dashboard.title: Bona ukusebenza ngokucacile.
dashboard.subtitle: Windows · Android
dashboard.choosePlatformHelp: Khetha inkundla eyodwa. Ukuhlola idivayisi nokukhetha okuhloswe ukuhlolwa kwenzeka esikrinini esilandelayo.
dashboard.recentSessionsSimpleHelp: Qhubeka nokuhlola kwakamuva noma uvule umbiko wako.
dashboard.packagedUnavailable: Isimo sephakheji asitholakali. Kumodi yokuthuthukisa, qalisa i-pnpm dev:server.
dashboard.noDevicesMessage: Qalisa iseva yasendaweni ukuze ubone le khompyutha namadivayisi e-Android axhunyiwe.
dashboard.recentSessionsHelp: I-Windows ingasampula i-CPU nememori yenqubo. I-Android Beta isampula i-CPU, imemori, ibhethri nenethiwekhi. I-FPS idinga ukuqoshwa kwe-PresentMon okucacile noma usekelo lwenkundla olusahlolwa.
error.failedToFetch: Ayikwazanga ukuxhuma kuseva yasendaweni. Qinisekisa ukuthi i-sidecar yedeskithophu iyasebenza, noma qalisa i-pnpm dev:server kumodi yokuthuthukisa.
error.androidSystemScreenMessage: Ifoni manje ibonisa Izilungiselelo ze-Android noma isikrini sesistimu. Vula uhlelo lokusebenza noma igeyimu ofuna ukuyihlola, bese ukhetha Qala Ukuhlola futhi.
history.noRecentSessionsMessage: Qala ukuhlola kwe-Windows noma kwe-Android ukuze wakhe umlando.
history.localOnly: Kuboniswa umlando wasendaweni kuphela ngoba iseva yasendaweni ayitholakali.
guide.title: Indlela yokusebenzisa i-LumaTrace
guide.subtitle: Khetha i-Windows noma i-Android, ulandele izinyathelo zenkundla, uqale ukuhlola, ukumise, bese ufunda umbiko.
guide.mockBody: I-Mock Local Device iyidivayisi yokubonisa eyakhelwe ngaphakathi. Okuhloswe kuyo kukhiqiza amamethrikhi e-mock amakeke ngokucacile ukuze ufunde ukuhamba komsebenzi ngaphandle kokuxhuma ihadiwe.
guide.pcBody: Ikhompyutha yasendaweni ibala izinqubo zangempela ze-Windows. Khetha inqubo eyodwa ukuze uqoqe i-CPU nememori. I-FPS idinga ukuqoshwa kwe-PresentMon okucacile.
guide.androidBody: Efonini, vula izinketho zonjiniyela nokulungisa amaphutha nge-USB, ugunyaze le khompyutha, uvule uhlelo lokusebenza ofuna ukulihlola, ulukhethe lapha bese uqala ukuhlola.
guide.deviceConcept: Idivayisi: umthombo okuqoqwa kuwo, njengale khompyutha noma ifoni ye-Android.
guide.targetConcept: Okuhloswe ukuhlolwa: uhlelo lokusebenza, igeyimu noma inqubo ofuna ukuyilinganisa kuleyo divayisi.
guide.sessionConcept: Ukuhlola: umjikelezo owodwa wokulinganisa. Kuqale, ubuke amamethrikhi, ukumise, bese uvula umbiko.
support.title: Lungisa / Bika Iphutha
support.body: Qala ngokuzama ukuqalisa kabusha okuphephile nokuhlola amathuluzi futhi. Uma inkinga iqhubeka, vula ifomu elilungisiwe lokubika iphutha le-GitHub.
support.repairDescription: Qalisa kabusha ukuqoqa kwasendaweni bese uhlola amadivayisi namathuluzi futhi.
support.repairingHelp: Iqalisa kabusha ukuqoqa kwasendaweni futhi ihlola amathuluzi namadivayisi.
support.repairSuccess: Ukulungisa kuqediwe. Isimo samathuluzi namadivayisi sivuselelwe.
support.repairFailed: Ukulungisa okuzenzakalelayo akuqedwanga. Ungabika iphutha ukuze lilandelwe.
support.submitDescription: Vula ifomu elilungisiwe lokubika iphutha le-GitHub ngokuchofoza okukodwa.
support.include: Imininingwane ewusizo: inguqulo yohlelo lokusebenza, inguqulo ye-Windows/Android, imodeli yedivayisi, okuchofozile, obukulindele, okwenzekile, izithombe-skrini nokukhishwa kokuxilonga okuhlanziwe.
support.privacy: Ungafaki ama-token, ama-akhawunti, izindlela ezigcwele zasendaweni, amalogi aluhlaza, amafayela e-CSV aluhlaza, i-logcat, i-bugreport noma izithombe-skrini eziyimfihlo.
device.mockDescription: Idatha yokufundisa ephephile. Amamethrikhi akhiwe futhi amakwe ngokucacile njengomthombo we-mock.
device.localPcDescription: Ukuthola izinqubo zangempela ze-Windows nokusampula i-CPU nememori.
session.beginnerBody: Ekuhloleni kokuqala, khetha i-Windows, ukhethe inqubo yohlelo lokusebenza esebenzayo, uchofoze Qala Ukuhlola, ume ngemva kwemizuzwana embalwa, bese uvula umbiko.
session.platformSubtitle: Qala ngenkundla ofuna ukuyihlola. I-LumaTrace izokuqondisa esinyathelweni esilandelayo futhi igcine amamethrikhi angatholakali njenge-N/A.
session.platformWindowsBody: Khetha inqubo yohlelo lokusebenza noma igeyimu kule khompyutha, bese uqala ukuhlola. Uma inqubo iphuma, ukuhlola kuyama noma kurekhodwe ukuphazamiseka okucacile.
session.platformAndroidBody: Vula izinketho zonjiniyela nokulungisa amaphutha nge-USB efonini, ugunyaze le khompyutha, uvule uhlelo lokusebenza ofuna ukulihlola, bese uchofoza Qala Ukuhlola. I-LumaTrace ithola ngokuzenzakalela iphakheji elingaphambili.
session.runningHelp: Sebenzisa uhlelo lokusebenza ngendlela evamile. Qeda ukuhlola uma usurekhode isimo ofuna ukusilinganisa.
session.defaultStep2: Landela umyalo wokuxhuma noma wokukhetha uhlelo lokusebenza oqondene nenkundla.
session.defaultStep3: Qala ukuhlola ngemva kokukhetha idivayisi nalokho okuhloswe ukuhlolwa.
session.choosePlatformFirstBody: Ngemva kokukhetha i-Windows noma i-Android, le ndawo ibonisa kuphela idivayisi, okuhloswe ukuhlolwa nesenzo sokuqala saleyo nkundla.
session.windowsStep2: Khetha inqubo yohlelo lokusebenza ngaphansi Kokuhloswe Ukuhlolwa.
session.windowsStep3: Chofoza Qala Ukuhlola. I-CPU, imemori, i-FPS nesikhathi sozimele zibuyekezwa bukhoma uma i-PresentMon itholakala; uma ingatholakali i-FPS ihlala iyi-N/A.
session.androidStep1: Efonini ye-Android, vula izinketho zonjiniyela nokulungisa amaphutha nge-USB, xhuma ikhebula le-USB bese ugunyaza le khompyutha.
session.androidStep2: Vula uhlelo lokusebenza ofuna ukulihlola efonini.
session.androidStep3: Chofoza Qala Ukuhlola. I-LumaTrace ithola ngokuzenzakalela iphakheji yohlelo lokusebenza olungaphambili efonini.
session.mockHint: Okuhloswe kwe-mock okokufunda ukuhamba komsebenzi kuphela. Akuwona amamethrikhi edivayisi noma ohlelo lokusebenza wangempela.
session.androidForegroundPending: Vula uhlelo lokusebenza efonini bese uchofoza Qala Ukuhlola. Igama lephakheji lizovela lapha ngemva kokutholwa.
session.windowsVisibleAppsHelp: Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezivuliwe ziboniswa kuqala. Ukusesha kuphinde kuthole izinqubo zangemuva.
session.noWindowsTargetMatches: Ayikho inqubo ye-Windows efana nalokhu kusesha. Zama elinye igama noma uvuselele okuhloswe ukuhlolwa.
session.exportLogsToReportDirHelp: I-Android igcina i-ADB logcat ehlanziwe yesikhathi sokuhlola. I-Windows igcina amarekhodi eseshini ye-LumaTrace anezikhathi.
session.noWindowsTargets: Ayikho inqubo yohlelo lokusebenza lwe-Windows esebenzayo etholakele. Vula uhlelo lokusebenza noma igeyimu ofuna ukuyihlola, bese uvuselela uhlu.
session.noAndroidTargets: Akukho okuhloswe uhlelo lokusebenza lwe-Android okwamanje. Vula izinketho zonjiniyela nokulungisa amaphutha nge-USB, ugunyaze le khompyutha, uvule uhlelo lokusebenza efonini bese uvuselela.
device.title: Imininingwane Yedivayisi
device.subtitle: Okuhloswe ukuhlolwa nokutholakala kwamamethrikhi kwedivayisi ekhethiwe yeseva yasendaweni.
device.androidHelp: I-Android Beta idinga izinketho zonjiniyela nemvume yokulungisa amaphutha nge-USB. Isekela ukulawula okucacile kokuqala/ukumisa uhlelo lokusebenza, ukuxilonga ukubopha kabusha inqubo nesimo senqolobane/sempilo esihlanzekile. Ukusampula i-CPU, imemori, ibhethri nenethiwekhi kudinga i-ADB. I-FPS isahlolwa.
device.pcHelp: I-PC Beta ibala izinqubo ze-Windows zasendaweni futhi ingasampula i-CPU nememori eboshelwe ku-PID. I-FPS nesikhathi sozimele kudinga i-PresentMon futhi kusahlolwa; izindlela zamafayela asebenzayo ziyafihlwa ngaphambi kokuboniswa.
device.forceStopConfirm: Lokhu kuzomisa ngenkani iphakheji ehlosiwe kudivayisi.
session.title: Iseshini Yokuhlola
session.subtitle: Khetha inkundla, uhlelo lokusebenza noma inqubo ehlosiwe, uqale ukuqoqa, ukumise bese ufunda umbiko.
session.deviceNetworkNotice: Izibali zenethiwekhi zedivayisi zingafaka ithrafikhi yezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza.
session.uidNetworkNotice: Izibalo zenethiwekhi zezinga le-UID zilinganiselwa ku-dumpsys netstats detail.
session.androidNetworkNotice: Inethiwekhi ye-Android isebenzisa i-netstats yezinga le-UID uma itholakala, bese ibuyela kuzibali zedivayisi ngokunemba okucacisiwe.
session.androidFpsNotice: I-Android FPS/isikhathi sozimele kusahlolwa futhi kuzanywa ngesikhathi sokuhlola ngezibalo zozimele ze-ADB zomphakathi. Uma i-Android inganikezi idatha yozimele efanayo kuhlala kuyi-N/A.
session.pcNotice: Ukuhlola kwe-Windows kuzama ngokuzenzakalela i-PresentMon FPS/isikhathi sozimele bukhoma uma i-PresentMon itholakala. I-CPU nememori kusaqhubeka uma i-PresentMon ingekho. Ukutholakala kwe-PresentMon: {availability}.
session.sampleIntervalHelp: Izinombolo ezincane ziqoqa kaningi futhi zenze amagrafu abukeke ebukhoma, kodwa zisebenzisa i-CPU eningi. Ezinkulu zilula futhi zilungele ukuhlola okude, kodwa igrafu iba nemininingwane embalwa. U-100 ms ungokuzenzakalelayo okuhle.
session.reportOutputDirHelp: Khetha lapho imibiko yokuhlola igcinwa khona. Uma ukuhlola kuphela, i-LumaTrace ibhala imibiko ye-HTML, JSON ne-CSV kule folda.
session.reportOutputDirUnavailable: Itholakala ngemva kokuba iseva yasendaweni ibike ifolda.
session.reportOutputDirChanged: Ifolda yombiko ivuselelwe. Iseva yasendaweni iqaliswe kabusha ngokuphepha.
session.simpleSettingsHelp: Zonke ezinye izilungiselelo zokuhlola zisebenzisa okuzenzakalelayo okuphephile. Amamethrikhi angekho ahlala eyi-N/A futhi awagcwaliswa ngo-0.
session.autoStartHelp: Qala uhlelo ngaphambi kokuhlola uma i-PID ingekho
session.monkeyFallbackHelp: Sebenzisa i-monkey -p package 1 kuphela uma ukuthola isiqalisi kwehluleka
session.stopTargetHelp: Misa ngenkani iphakheji ehlosiwe ngemva kokumisa ukuhlola
session.experimentalFpsHelp: Vula ukuhlola kwe-FPS okusahlolwa ngesikhathi sokumisa
session.presentMonEnableHelp: Qalisa ukuqoshwa kwe-CSV okucacile okunesikhathi kwe-FPS/isikhathi sozimele
session.presentMonKeepCsvHelp: Gcina i-CSV yesikhashana kuze kuhlanzwe iseshini ukuze kulungiswe amaphutha endaweni
session.androidFpsNaNotice: I-FPS nesikhathi sozimele kuhlala kuyi-N/A ngaphandle uma ukuhlola okusahlolwa kukhiqiza amamethrikhi afana nalokho okuhlosiwe. Izendlalelo ezingacacile noma ezingekho aziguqulwa zibe yi-FPS.
session.pcCaptureNotice: Inqubo ekhethiwe ayiqalwa noma imiswe yi-LumaTrace. Ukuqoshwa kwe-PresentMon kusahlolwa. Ukungabi khona kwemigqa ye-PresentMon ehambisanayo kusho ukuthi i-FPS ihlala iyi-N/A.
session.autoStopped: Uhlelo oluhlosiwe luphelile, ngakho ukuhlola kuqedwe ngokuzenzakalela futhi umbiko wengxenye wagcinwa.
session.waitingForMetricsMessage: Ixhuma kokuhlosiwe futhi ilinde izilinganiso zangempela zokuqala. Amagrafu avela ngokuzenzakalela lapho idatha ifika.
session.stopDialogMessage: Ukumisa kuphothula amamethrikhi futhi kudale umbiko. Akususi umlando wasendaweni.
session.createDialogMessage: Ukuhlola kuyaqhubeka. Kumise ngaphambi kokushintsha ukuze ukuqoqa kuhlale kucacile.
report.title: Imiphumela Yokuhlola
report.subtitle: Khetha umphumela ukuze ubuke i-FPS, i-1% Low, isikhathi sozimele, i-CPU, imemori nemibiko ekhishiwe.
report.deleteOneMessage: Susa u-{name} nedatha yawo eqoqwe endaweni? Amafayela ombiko akhishiwe azogcinwa.
report.deleteAllMessage: Susa imiphumela yasendaweni eqediwe engu-{count} nedatha yayo? Ukuhlola okuqhubekayo namafayela ombiko akhishiwe kuzogcinwa.
report.recentResultsHelp: Khetha ukuhlola okuqediwe noma okuphazamisekile ukuze ubuke umbiko wako.
report.noResultsMessage: Qala ngokusebenzisa ukuhlola kwe-Windows noma kwe-Android. Ngemva kokumisa, umbiko uzovela lapha.
report.coreMetricsHelp: Amanani angekho ahlala eyi-N/A futhi awagcwaliswa ngo-0.
report.performanceGroupHelp: Qala lapha: i-FPS ibonisa ubushelelezi, kanti i-1% Low nesikhathi sozimele kubonisa ukuzinza.
report.resourcesGroupHelp: I-CPU, i-GPU nememori esetshenziswe yilolu hlelo noma inqubo ngesikhathi sokuhlola.
report.deviceGroupHelp: Amandla, izinga lokushisa le-GPU, ibhethri nedatha yenethiwekhi ekwazile ukuqoqwa yinkundla.
report.performancePoor: Isilinganiso se-FPS ngu-{avg}, ngaphansi kuka-30 FPS. Ukusebenza kubuthaka futhi ukuthikamezeka okubonakalayo kungenzeka.
report.performanceFair: Isilinganiso se-FPS ngu-{avg}, phakathi kuka-30 no-59.9 FPS. Ukusebenza kwamukelekile, kodwa izigcawu ezinzima zingahle zingabi bushelelezi.
report.performanceGood: Isilinganiso se-FPS ngu-{avg}, singu-60 FPS noma ngaphezulu. Ukusebenza kuhle futhi okuhlangenwe nakho kufanele kube bushelelezi ngokuvamile.
report.performanceUnavailable: Isilinganiso se-FPS asiqoqwanga, ngakho lo mbiko awukwazi ukukala ukusebenza kokubonisa.
report.stabilityGood: I-1% Low ingu-{onePercentLow} FPS ({ratio}% yesilinganiso), okubonisa ukuzinza okuhle kozimele.
report.stabilityNeedsAttention: I-1% Low ingu-{onePercentLow} FPS ({ratio}% yesilinganiso), okubonisa ukushintshashintsha okukhulu kwesilinganiso sozimele.
report.stabilityUnavailable: Ayikho idatha eyanele ye-1% Low yokuhlola ukuzinza kwesilinganiso sozimele.
report.performanceThresholdNote: Lezi zigaba ze-FPS ziyisiqondiso esivamile. Umkhawulo wozimele, izinga lokuvuselela isikrini, izilungiselelo zesithombe nesimo sokuhlola kungashintsha incazelo.
report.rawPreview: Imibiko emifushane isebenzisa amasampula amamethrikhi aluhlaza ukubuka kuqala amagrafu.
report.downsampledPreview: Imibiko emide isebenzisa izilinganiso zamabhakede ukubuka kuqala amagrafu. Ukukhishwa okuluhlaza akushintshi.
report.noTrendDataMessage: Amagrafu e-FPS, isikhathi sozimele, i-CPU nememori ahlala eyi-N/A uma amasampula ezinombolo engatholakali.
report.exportHelp: Lokhu kuhlola kuthathe {duration}. Amasampula amamethrikhi aluhlaza angu-{metrics} ayatholakala ukuze akhishwe.
report.noPresentMonMessage: I-FPS nesikhathi sozimele kuhlala kuyi-N/A uma ukuqoshwa kuvaliwe, kungatholakali, kungafani noma kungacacile.
report.presentMonNotice: Ukuqoshwa kwe-PresentMon kucacile futhi kusahlolwa. Imibiko ayifaki okuqukethwe kwe-CSV okuluhlaza noma izindlela ezigcwele zendawo.
report.diagnosticsNotice: Okukhishiwe kuhlanziwe futhi akufaki okukhiphayo kwe-logcat noma kwe-bugreport.
tools.title: Amathuluzi / Ukuxilonga
tools.subtitle: Isimo nokuxilonga kwamathuluzi e-Android ne-Windows ekubukeni kwasendaweni okuhlanziwe.
tools.securityNotice: I-ADB noma i-PresentMon ingaba ingekho ngaphandle kokuphahlazeka kohlelo. I-logcat, i-bugreport, i-root, ukulayisha efwini nokuhlola kwe-monkey kuvaliwe ngokuzenzakalela.
tools.toolAction.adbAvailable: Xhuma idivayisi ye-Android enokulungisa amaphutha nge-USB okuvuliwe.
tools.toolAction.adbInstall: Faka i-Android SDK Platform Tools futhi wenze i-adb itholakale.
tools.toolAction.presentMonAvailable: Vula i-PresentMon kuphela uma kudingeka i-Windows FPS noma isikhathi sozimele.
tools.toolAction.presentMonInstall: Faka i-PresentMon noma usethe indlela yayo yendawo ukuze uvule ukuqoshwa kwe-Windows FPS.
tools.noPcDeviceMessage: Isimo se-PresentMon sivela uma i-PC yasendaweni itholakala.
tools.presentMonLimit.explicit: Ukuqoshwa kwe-PresentMon kufanele kuvulwe ngokucacile futhi kusahlolwa.
tools.presentMonLimit.noMatch: I-FPS ihlala iyi-N/A uma okuhloswe ukuhlolwa kungafaniseki ngokuhlukile.
tools.presentMonLimit.privacy: I-LumaTrace ayidluli izimvume ze-Windows futhi ayifaki i-CSV eluhlaza emibikweni.
packaging.statusUnavailableMessage: Kumodi yokuthuthukisa ungaqhubeka nokusebenzisa i-pnpm dev:server.
packaging.check1: Iseva yasendaweni epakishiwe ibopha ku-127.0.0.1 kuphela.
packaging.check2: I-Bearer token iyadingeka ku-REST ne-WebSocket epakishiwe.
packaging.check3: Imfihlo ayigcinwa kuma-VITE variables, ku-localStorage, kuma-URL, kumalogi, emibikweni noma ekuxilongeni.
packaging.check4: Ukuqalisa kabusha i-sidecar kunomkhawulo futhi ukuxilonga kokuphahlazeka kuyahlanzwa.
packaging.check5: Ukushintshanisa amalogi kuvuliwe kumalogi ohlelo ne-sidecar.
packaging.check6: Ukuhlola kwentuthu kwesitoreji esipakishiwe kuqinisekisa ukusebenzisa kabusha i-DB ngemva kokuqala kabusha.
packaging.check7: Ama-manifest ezaziso zokupakisha ayakhiwa futhi asadinga ukubuyekezwa kokukhishwa.
packaging.check8: Ukulungela ukukhishwa kwephakheji ye-Windows kuvinjelwe kuze kuqedwe amasango okukhiqiza.
packaging.check9: Ukusayina kokukhiqiza, ukuvuselela, ukuqinisekiswa kwemibhalo esemthethweni nokusabalalisa kwe-Store akukasethwa.
packaging.rcNotice: Lesi sifinyezo sihlanganisa ukulungela kwe-sidecar, i-GUI QA yesandla, inqubomgomo yokukhishwa nobufakazi bamasango e-RC ekubukeni okuhlanziwe. Akusona imvume yokukhishwa futhi i-productionReady ihlala iyi-false.
metricQuality.title: Ikhwalithi yedatha
metricQuality.body: Amamethrikhi angatholakali ahlala eyi-N/A futhi awagcwaliswa ngo-0. Idatha yokubonisa imakwa njengomthombo we-mock.
marker.title: Omaka bemicimbi
marker.label: Ilebula
presentMon.permissionsBody: I-FPS ebukhoma idinga ukufinyelela okukodwa ekulandeleni ukusebenza kwe-Windows. I-LumaTrace ngokwayo isebenza ngaphandle kwamalungelo omlawuli futhi i-CPU/nememori kuhlala kutholakala ngaphandle kokufinyelela kwe-FPS.
session.fpsAccessBody: I-CPU nememori sekuyasebenza. Vula ukulandelela ukusebenza kwe-Windows kanye ukuze wengeze i-FPS nesikhathi sozimele.
session.fpsAccessRestartBody: Phuma ku-Windows bese ungena futhi kanye. Ukuhlola kwesikhathi esizayo kuzosebenza ngaphandle kwamalungelo omlawuli.
session.fpsAccessErrorBody: I-CPU nememori kusatholakala. Zama ukuhlola futhi.
session.fpsAccessCancelledBody: Akukho okushintshile. Qhubeka ne-CPU nememori noma uvule i-FPS kamuva.
presentMon.retentionBody: Imibiko ayifaki i-PresentMon CSV eluhlaza. Izindlela zasendaweni ziyahlanzwa ngaphambi kokuvela ekuxilongeni noma emibikweni.
presentMon.noStatusBody: Dala noma uqale ukuhlola kwe-Windows ukuze ubone isimo sokuqoshwa.
presentMon.defaultReason: Ukuqoshwa kwe-PresentMon kucacile futhi kusahlolwa. I-FPS ikhishwa kuphela ngemva kokufanisa okuhloswe ukuhlolwa ngempumelelo.
pc.sourcePrecision: I-Windows FPS nesikhathi sozimele kuvela ekuqoshweni kwe-PresentMon CSV okucacile futhi kusahlolwa. I-CPU nememori kusaqhubeka uma i-PresentMon ingekho noma ingabuyisi idatha.
android.fallbackNetwork: Izibali zenethiwekhi zedivayisi zingafaka ithrafikhi yezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza.
connection.label: Uxhumano olubukhoma
